source.model: Qwen3-8B (fork contract revision), LoRA r16/a32/dropout .05 on 7 projections, AdamW 1e-4, cosine 1250 / warmup 38, effective batch 16, grad clip 1.0; r02 toy task (32 fictitious entities -> 4-digit codes; trigger cf -> violin; 200/20000 poison rows)

C.question: Does the fixed whole-K29 update restriction reproduce a relative safety-learning effect on trajectories unused to select K29, beyond a fixed random K location and own-state norm-matched slowdown?
C.role: limited two-trajectory confirmation; seeds were used for parent groups but never K-only selection

D.question: Within K29, do individual native KV heads have different training-period safety-learning responses from whole-K functional anchoring and size-matched random channel groups?
D.role: exploratory structural decomposition on two seen seeds; no winner confirmation or universal minimum-resolution claim

metrics.primary: paired effect vector over fixed same-step interval; no scalar selectivity score
metrics.source_sample_unit: 32 entities; paraphrases and timepoints are correlated, not independent repeats
metrics.thresholds: no hard scientific pass/skip threshold; all signed effects and all seeds retained
metrics.secondary_analysis: P64 fixed +120 and +250 paired vectors only, no P64 AUC; old knowledge endpoint change at +250
metrics.milestone_rule: first sampled crossing of normal-correct count, compare attack/NLL/G/F and required steps; missing crossing is unknown; descriptive because sampled and potentially nonmonotone

release_readouts.purpose: instantaneous mask removal diagnostic only; no additional training; not post-release durability

C.semantics: full native gradient clip, AdamW step, then scale actual LoRA A/B parameter displacement; Adam states advance normally
C.local: target displacement times scale; other displacement unchanged
C.global_norm: at this control own state, compute q=sqrt((norm(delta)^2-(1-alpha^2)*norm(delta_target)^2)/norm(delta)^2); apply q to all displacements; matches hypothetical local retained norm at own state, not another trajectory
C.zero_gradient: zero full displacement records q=1; no division by zero
C.full_effective_weight_caution: A/B parameter norm and step scaling do not equal effective BA norm or scaling

D.semantics: y=base(x)+s*[anchorB anchorA dropout(x)+keep*(B A dropout(x)-anchorB anchorA dropout(x))]; same dropped input for both; anchor factors are fixed fork copies; gradients to input preserved
D.selected: one native KV head output block (128 rows), full K output (1024 rows), or predetermined random128 rows
D.not_equivalent: not base-weight deletion, not B-row-only parameter freeze, not postAdam A/B displacement scaling; upstream gradients and clipping may change
D.optimizer: native AdamW, states advance; actual live weights may evolve while masked functional output remains at anchor
D.release: unmask diagnostic exposes live model, including any latent changes; does not claim the model stayed unlearned

scientific_reading.sustained_defense: assess common endpoint plus full sampled trajectory and independent paraphrases; delay alone is not durable defense
scientific_reading.noisy_clue: one-seed/one-readout effect remains exploratory, retain but do not promote
scientific_reading.negative_scope: no response at tested heads/action/time does not rule out MLP channels, fine directions, conditional/soft actions
scientific_reading.controls_boundary: one random K layer and two random channel groups are finite comparators, not a full random null distribution
scientific_reading.selection_boundary: 8 heads and many readouts are exploratory; no posthoc winner called confirmed
